Question ID: fb17d540
Assessment Test Domain Skill Difficulty
PSAT 8/9 Reading and Writing Craft and Structure Words in Context Medium
Question
Anthropologist Kristian J. Carlson and colleagues examined the fossilized clavicle and shoulder bones of Little Foot.
Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
Answer
1. surpassed by
2. comparable to
3. independent of
4. obtained from
Correct Answer: B
Rationale
Choice B is the best answer because it most logically completes the text.
